multifactorial_stress_index.note: PC1 of deseasonalised T/S/CO2/O2/pH anomalies. Its correlation with EC50 is co-trended, not causal.

verdict: Pettitt break in EC50: last month before the change 2016-05, first month after 2016-06 (p=8.6e-23, significant at 0.05). MHW exposure (total MHW days): last year before the change 2013, first year after 2014 (p=0.0019, significant at 0.05). Comparing the last period before each break, the MHW-exposure break is 3 yr earlier than the EC50 break. PC1 explains 71% of the variance of the deseasonalised T/S/CO2/O2/pH anomalies. Critical-slowing-down early-warning signals (rolling variance AND lag-1 autocorrelation both rising, Kendall p<0.05): not detected (variance tau=-0.51, p=2.7e-18; AR(1) tau=+0.14, p=0.016).
